Internal helper: the code and the label behind each of jfreq()'s Valid rows

Source: R/descriptives.R
dot-jst_freq_codes.Rd

jfreq() tabulates a factor of display strings: a labelled variable's values formatted under the call's value.id mode ("1: Male", "Male" or "1") and capped at 40 columns, a numeric variable's numbers as text. The stored Value column is that string. This returns, for each row, the value itself and its label whole (Session 399, Capability Slate T's build 0), from the map the tabulating branch kept: each display string beside the code it was made from, zero rows (a labelled value no case holds) included. A text variable, a factor and any other type have no map: the row's text is its own code, and it has no label.

Usage

.jst_freq_codes(value, lvl_map)

Arguments

value

Character; the Valid rows' Value column.

lvl_map

NULL, or a list: level (the display strings), code (the code each was made from, the same length) and labels (the variable's value labels, or NULL).

Value

A list: code (numeric or character) and label (character, NA where there is none), one element per row.
